title: Fair and cheap: eight task designs for frontier evaluation in quantitative finance (MRF-2026-04 reproducibility data)
description: Reproducibility data for Montana Research Foundation preprint MRF-2026-04, "Fair and cheap: eight task designs for frontier evaluation in quantitative finance": per-rollout aggregate records for the one probed cell, the consolidated gate-0 dataset every value in the manuscript is drawn from, each carrying its source and the method that produced it, and a self-contained verify.py that recounts the designs and recomputes the probe from this bundle alone. Task families, screening spike code, raw agent transcripts, and held-out grading data are withheld under contamination control.
